import Mathlib.Data.Finset
import Mathlib.Nat.Basic

open Nat

theorem lg_target : (Finset.filter (fun n => n % 3 = 0) (Finset.range 30)).card = 10 := by
  rw [Nat.count_eq_card_filter_range]
  have h_count_val : Nat.count (fun n => n % 3 = 0) 30 = 10 := by
    let m := 30
    let k := m / 3
    have h : k = 10 := by simp
    rw [h]
    exact Nat.count_divisible_by_self
  rfl
